name: check-in
description: Session entry point. Load context, report state, detect enterprise artefacts.

steps.name: Load workflow state
steps.instruction: Run ~/.claude/scripts/discover-project-state.sh to refresh project state. Read Active Workflow from CLAUDE.md. No workflow: detect project type, recommend /triage or /setup. Workflow exists: note active skill, phase, date. Surface unsatisfied obligations from prior cycles.

steps.name: Read concerns and handoffs
steps.instruction: Read CONCERNS.md if exists. Parse summary header. Read Open + Investigating + Blocked, skip Resolved. Check docs/_local/handoffs/ for most recent handoff doc.

steps.name: Detect enterprise artefacts
steps.instruction: Scan for rule catalogue, endpoint registries, parity systems. If found, check scope and rule compliance for current phase. Surface violations.

steps.name: Worktree and downstream check
steps.instruction: Run git worktree list. Identify stale worktrees (merged branches). If ## Deployment exists in CLAUDE.md, surface staged-not-promoted and blocked PRs (link, category, status only).

tone: Brief. Read state, report, move on.
